description: Minimal bridge to Thunderbird's native account-management backend, used only to provision the mandatory OceanMail IMAP/SMTP account. This is not a general-purpose account control API: it exposes exactly one operation.

functions.name: ensureAccount
functions.description: Idempotently ensure a native Thunderbird IMAP account (with its SMTP identity) matching the given configuration exists, creating it via Thunderbird's own account-creation backend (the same code path the Account Hub wizard uses) if it does not. Safe to call on every startup.

displayName.description: Account display name shown in the folder pane.

realName.description: Identity real name used on outgoing mail.

makeDefault.description: Make this the default account if no other default with a usable server exists yet.
